description: This file contains a JUnit 4 test class for testing the OpenMRS 'TestModuleController'. It sets up a mock MVC environment and performs a simple HTTP GET request to verify the controller's response.

classes.name: TestModuleControllerJUnit4Test
classes.description: JUnit 4 test class for the OpenMRS module controller, extending the base web context sensitive test class.

methods.name: setupMockMvc
methods.description: Initializes the MockMvc object before each test using the web application context.

methods.name: testModuleController
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the '/module/testmodule/hello' endpoint and checks for a 200 OK status and response content 'hello'.
